period_covered: Monthly reserve-attestation program announced in May 2025; current transparency index reviewed through June 2026 on 2026-08-22
publisher: MNEE Limited and Wolf & Company, P.C.
notes: The issuer announcement states that Wolf & Company performs monthly examinations using month-end and random intra-month snapshot dates and that reserves use U.S. Treasury bills with duration no longer than 90 days and U.S. cash held by a qualified custodian. The current transparency index lists June 2026, but the exact June 2026 report-body figures, signed report-specific URL, snapshot dates, assurance wording, and report-specific archive were not independently preserved. The current custodian name and latest category allocation remain unknown. No July 2026 attestation is established by the reviewed source.

period_covered: EUB MiCA whitepaper reserve, issuance, and redemption framework reviewed on 2026-08-03; not a token-specific reserve attestation
notes: The whitepaper supports par issuance and redemption and describes a conservative high-quality and liquid management framework for fiat proceeds. It does not establish current token-specific asset categories, amounts, shares, custodian identity, liabilities, excess reserves, or a token-specific audit or attestation opinion. Bison Bank's issuer-level Deloitte audit statement is not treated as EUB reserve assurance.
